periods.glance: Spanish Empire, 1976: monarchy in transition to democracy. About 35.2 million people in 1976 (estimate). Official religion: Catholicism. Leaders: Carlos Arias Navarro, Juan Carlos I of Spain, Adolfo Suárez and others.

Spanish Empire, 1977: monarchy in transition to democracy. About 35.6 million people in 1977 (estimate). Official religion: Catholicism. Ruling party: Union of the Democratic Centre (Adolfo Suárez). Leaders: Juan Carlos I of Spain, Adolfo Suárez.

Spanish Empire, 1979 to 1980: parliamentary constitutional monarchy. About 36.3 million people in 1979 (estimate). Official religion: none (1978 constitution). Ruling party: Union of the Democratic Centre (Adolfo Suárez). Leaders: Juan Carlos I of Spain, Adolfo Suárez, José Luis Leal Maldonado.
